summary: Defined the Distribution Alpha rootfs runtime artifact install manifest. The contract covers boot and managed agentd paths, policy pack, semantic tool manifest, ModelBroker config, persistent run/audit/rollback/memory directories, release provenance, and rootfs manifest metadata with validation labels for later automation.

acceptance_evidence.mandatory_artifact_coverage: The manifest includes every mandatory artifact class from the Distribution Alpha entry criteria.
acceptance_evidence.secret_safety: Every artifact carries no-secret-values or handle-metadata-only policy; ModelBroker config forbids raw credentials.
acceptance_evidence.boot_vs_runtime_path: The manifest distinguishes /sbin/agentd boot handoff from /usr/lib/agentos/agentd managed runtime path.
acceptance_evidence.validator_consumable: The schema defines stable artifact IDs and validation labels for TASK-DALPHA-003 automation.
acceptance_evidence.shell_denial: Semantic tool manifest rules explicitly exclude normal-mode shell.exec and require policy denial.
acceptance_evidence.offline_model_mode: ModelBroker config defaults to stub/local-only mode without network or external credentials.

verification.document_review: rootfs-runtime-install-manifest.md maps each artifact to path, kind, owner, mode, persistence, validation, source proof, and consuming future task.
verification.no_code_changes: This task is a contract/documentation task and does not modify Rust runtime code.
verification.generated_artifacts: No generated image, boot, target, cache, or release artifacts are part of this task.
